topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer development, tissue architecture, and cell culture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore cancer as a multistep disruption of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture while addressing the limitations of studying tumors in vitro.

topics.label: Benign versus malignant pathology, invasion, and nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distinguishing pathological features, stepwise invasive progression, and formal classification systems of benign and malignant tumors.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This topic explains the physiological mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause clinical illness and patient death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across humans and other species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the epidemiological patterns and incidence of various cancer types across human populations, domestic animals, and other multicellular taxa.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical symptoms of cancer and compare the efficacy and challenges of screening programs across different anatomical sites.

topics.label: Closing housekeeping and practical preview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture with review instructions and details for upcoming practical sessions.
